title: A model plugin composed from tested blocks by a layout, on the serving contracts every model plugin keeps
description: The architecture as blocks (grouped-query and gated softmax attention with query/key norms, biases, sliding windows and sinks; block-sparse attention whose blocks an indexer picks; multi-head latent attention; gated delta-rule layers; rows of a hashed n-gram table gated into the residual; a SwiGLU MLP; a mixture of experts over any experts plugin, expert-offload included; the checkpoint's MTP layer as the device draft head) over a residual of one pre-norm stream or of several mixed streams, composed by a layout for the checkpoint's model_type (code/layouts) or the engine's own, on the serving contracts: exact rows (each prompt chunk alone with the prompt rows' arithmetic, one-token rows in calls of at most invariant_rows), prompt spans timed and sized at load (a measured decision) so every prompt step finishes inside crit serve's cancel grace and leaves the device's room, every device tensor planned through the placement plugin, Core's captured rounds (greedy and sampled, drafted from the MTP layer), captured prompt chunks, Core's prompt cache, fixed-text scores in the prompt's spans, constrained, replayed and plain requests.

layout.description: a layout file beside this plugin (code/layouts/*.json is the format); empty: the library's layout for the checkpoint's model_type

concurrency.description: requests decoding at once (Core's max_concurrency); each holds one recurrent state where the model has gated-delta layers

context.description: the context served when the loader names none

kv_margin.description: KV pool tokens beyond the served context, for requests beside the longest one

kv.description: KV page precision: auto takes fp8 with the checkpoint's static k_scale / v_scale where it stores them, else bf16

prefill_chunk.description: the longest prompt span: prompt tokens a step takes of one request (Core's prefill_chunk and work quantum)

span_seconds.description: the time a prompt step may take at any position: spans are timed at load (a short and a full chunk at position 0, a full chunk at the deepest position served) and each position takes the longest span predicted within it. crit serve retires an engine whose cancel does not settle within one second, and a cancel settles between steps, so the default is three quarters of that: a step's fixed part (an experts plugin's copies of a chunk's experts) is paid once a step, and a smaller budget pays it for fewer tokens. Where that part alone passes the budget, spans are the ones that prefill fastest (the facts' spans.over_budget). 0: every span the prefill chunk, untimed

passes.description: prompt spans run layer by layer (a pass: every chunk of a span through one layer, then through the next, over as many of Core's steps as that takes, each within span_seconds). auto: where the experts plugin brings a prompt chunk's experts to the device (expert-offload with experts in host memory or a file), so each layer's experts cross the link once a span instead of once a chunk; on: always; off: never. A pass changes no token: a chunk through a layer is the same call in either order

pass_mib.description: the most device memory a pass's chunks keep their residual states in between layers (an elastic expert cache gives it and takes it back after the pass): what bounds a pass's tokens, a prefill chunk at least

headroom_mib.description: device memory a prompt step leaves free at its peak beyond the placement's own reserve: the run's VRAM headroom where the placement keeps none (expert-offload keeps its own margin)

activations_mib.description: MiB planned on the device for a step's activations and scoring temporaries

release_below_mib.description: MiB of free device memory under which torch's cached blocks go back when a prompt or a score ends

prompt_cache.description: ended requests' sequences kept in Core's prompt cache (0: none): a prompt that begins as one of them did prefills only the rest

rounds.description: decode rows through Core's captured rounds (native rounds); false: every row through step()

prompt_buckets.description: comma-separated token counts of captured prompt chunks (crit_plugins.prompt_graphs); empty: every chunk eager

mtp.description: the checkpoint's MTP layer (the layout's draft prefix) as the device draft head, with a drafter in the selection

widths.description: comma-separated round widths the width policy chooses among (the widest always one)

mtp_encode.description: draft-only re-encoding of the MTP layer's matrices

draft_head.description: the draft steps' head: the target's (shared) or a draft-only copy re-encoded

draft_head_slices.description: row slices of a re-encoded draft head

kernel_tuning.description: a folder beside this plugin holding crit kernels sweep tables (<kernel>.json) the engine's kernels build with; empty: CRIT_KERNEL_TUNING or the kernels' default knobs

kernels.name: sparse-indexer
kernels.fallback: an indexed attention's blocks scored in torch a token at a time and chosen by Core's topk_blocks (the same canonical choice, slower at long contexts)
